These compounds are also targets of Isoamyl isothiocyanate, which further links to GAPDH. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, with Chakasaponin Iii being a potential modulator of GAPDH through its interaction with Kv3.3. The evidence suggests that Chakasaponin Iii may influence GAPDH activity via a downstream pathway involving Kv3.3, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated. The presence of multiple compounds with similar targets reinforces the possibility of a broader regulatory network, but the specific role of Chakasaponin Iii in this context requires further investigation.
